notes.title: V 1.06 - Minor Localization fix
notes.content:
- rewrote code for first time start up to work better with steam's set localization
- increased start up screen from 200 ms to 400 ms to allow Unity's localization more time to initiate on slower PC's.

If you are still experiencing bugs with the game, please message me on steam or my email at ArchDawnDev@gmail.com

notes.title: V1.05 Undead Buff
notes.content:
Increased undead corpses at start by 1.
Changed "The Legion" alliance perk from "25% chance to recover a corpse upon unit death" to "Recover 025 corpses upon unit death.
small bug fixes.

notes.title: Extra content delay
notes.content: The Raiders, Immortal, and Faithful content is delayed for farther testing. Until then, the AI and testers will still have access to that content. I appreciate your patience and hope that everyone enjoys the free game until then. The DLC and a balance update will be published by Tuesday. Thank you.
